reviewed_by: Codex review of the Goal-mode live token counter journey
reason: Goal usage stayed at zero throughout an active provider stream because the panel rendered only Core's settled usage. The UI now adds an explicitly approximate, turn-local token estimate while text and reasoning stream, then refreshes Core's exact persisted goal after the turn settles. The focused component file covers estimated versus authoritative presentation and existing Goal lifecycle behavior. The selected Playwright entry proves that a healthy running goal becomes nonzero before the delayed provider completion and reconciles afterward on desktop Chromium, mobile Chromium, and mobile WebKit.
exclusions: Full frontend and Playwright suites are excluded. Python and native tests are excluded because no Core, API, persistence, provider adapter, or Rust code changed. Real-Core and LAN-origin gates are not selected because this is transient React presentation over an unchanged API contract and does not touch origin-sensitive browser capabilities. Physical-device testing is unavailable; permanent mobile profiles provide emulated Chromium and WebKit coverage.
